test.create_query: CREATE TABLE join_limit_probe (k UInt64, k2 UInt64, v String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE join_limit_build (k UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE join_limit_dense (k UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO join_limit_probe SELECT number % 10000, number % 10000, toString(number) FROM numbers_mt(100000000)
INSERT INTO join_limit_dense SELECT number FROM numbers(10000)
